question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?
sql:
-- Show all possible years_elapsed values (31-49) and which have legislators
WITH RECURSIVE dec31_dates AS (
    SELECT DATE '1789-12-31' as dec31
    UNION ALL
    SELECT dec31 + INTERVAL '1 year'
    FROM dec31_dates
    WHERE dec31 < DATE '2025-12-31'
),
male_la_legislators AS (
    SELECT 
        l.id_bioguide,
        MIN(CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE)) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
    GROUP BY l.id_bioguide
),
legislator_years AS (
    SELECT 
        m.id_bioguide,
        d.dec31,
        CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dec31) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.first_term_start) AS INTEGER) as years_elapsed
    FROM male_la_legislators m
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON m.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    JOIN dec31_dates d ON CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= d.dec31 AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= d.dec31
    WHERE CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dec31) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.first_term_start) AS INTEGER) > 30 
      AND CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dec31) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.first_term_start) AS INTEGER) < 50
)
SELECT 
    years_elapsed,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) as distinct_legislators
FROM legislator_years
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed
